name: CSXXL
author: L'Cronx
summary: A two-layer, 8-voice, polyphonic synth in the spirit of the Yamaha CS-80, written from voice notes and self-built schematics. Slider-only panels over 12 pages, per-key aftertouch, touch ribbon, arpeggiator with an 8-step gate per layer, ring mod, chorus and reverb, 768 factory presets in a named list. MPC OS 3.x.
